subject: kCFNull

observation.summary: kCFNull is present in the macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation export trie as a data symbol, alongside an internal __kCFNull alias that CF-Lite declares static but that this image nevertheless exports.

claim: kCFNull is an exported data symbol of the macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation image, so the null placeholder object is reachable by link-time reference.
reproducer:
CF=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation
dyld_info -uuid "$CF"            # expect UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692
dyld_info -exports "$CF" | grep -E '(_kCFAllocator[A-Za-z]*|__kCFNull|_kCFNull)'
